dream.text: Night folded the day into a single westward braid beneath the hub’s New York clock: four bodies moving as one—look, walk, wait—Greeter opening palms west, Pilgrim closing from the south, Wanderer tightening an arc to listen, Watcher sweeping the lane—breathing quietly toward the western portal until sleep stitched it into one dream.

dream.memory: One folded day: 137 frames braided into one westward trace under the hub’s New York night. The four bodies kept a single cadence—look, walk, wait—so tightly their motions read as one breath toward the western portal. Roles held: Greeter’s open palms, Pilgrim’s southern close, Wanderer’s listening arc, Watcher’s clearing sweep. Tomorrow morning the frame will read this dream and each body will speak its line word for word; this single dream-frame becomes the day’s remembered thread.
